name: Flowering Can
skillFull: Flower seeds appear at certain intervals. Flowers begin to bloom after collecting a seed. At the tip of the fully grown flowers, a highly valuable Flower Crystal Jelly will also appear. Level Up for more points for Flower Crystal Jellies.
